environmentvariabledefinition.description: The Entra application (client) ID of the WordPress site, the only caller the intake endpoint accepts (NFR-008, C-TECH-006). The intake flow compares the appid claim on the incoming token against this value and rejects the request before any Dataverse write. A client ID is a public identifier, not a secret, so it is a plain environment variable and NOT a secret-type variable - the shared secret under the alternative intake route would be, and would have to be Key Vault backed (TAD section 6.3, ADR-011).
environmentvariabledefinition.hint: The WordPress caller's Entra application (client) ID, a GUID. Only required under the Entra OAuth intake route; left unset under the REST-pull alternative.
